sources.quote: Titel: Beantwortung der Frage: Was ist Aufklärung?
Immanuel Kant defines “enlightenment” in his famous contribution to debate on the question in an essay entitled “An Answer to the Question: What is Enlightenment?” (1784)
aus: Berlinische Monatsschrift , Bd. 4, 1784, Zwölftes Stück, S. 481–494

notes: Ghi chú mô hình dữ liệu (không phải lỗi dữ kiện): author=null dù Kant có hồ sơ trong people.yml (people/kant); có thể gán author: kant.
